notes.title: Demo Now Available
notes.content: [p]You are now able to download and enjoy the demo for Scurry![/p][p]The demo currently features two special squirrel types: Fire and Shock.[/p][p]I think you will find plenty to discover about these breeds, with lots of opportunity for unique and powerful builds.[/p][p]All feedback is welcome and appreciated as it helps to make Scurry better. You can leave feedback and report any issues on the respective discussion threads I will be creating in the Community Hub, or on [url="https://discord.gg/QwS4hW53RY"]Discord[/url].[/p][p]I will be working on controller support as my next step which should come as an update in the near future. There will likely be additional updates based on feedback I gather. I am always looking for ways it can be improved.[/p][p]This is a special milestone that I'm happy to be sharing with you all.[/p][p]Wishing you all the best.[/p]

notes.title: Scurry | Developer Welcome
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for checking out Scurry. I'm really excited to be sharing it after many months of development.[/p][p][/p][p]Keep an eye out for a demo sometime before October Next Fest. In the meantime I will be working hard to bring the vision to life.[/p][p][/p][p]The best place to follow development and ask questions is on [url="https://discord.scurry.gg"]Discord[/url]. You'll find a detailed FAQ there, and I will be checking in when I can.[/p][p][/p][p]A higher-quality standalone version of the trailer is available on [url="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kmP22Aum-4A"]Youtube[/url].[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you to everyone who wishlists and follows along with the journey. I can't wait for you to experience it.[/p][p][/p][p]- Identical Forest[/p]
